KNIGHTS, developed and published by Arzola's, is a minimalist yet deeply engaging puzzle game that challenges players to think creatively and strategically. Released in 2016, the game has received widespread acclaim on Steam for its elegant design and satisfying gameplay, achieving a “Very Positive” rating from a dedicated player base. At first glance, KNIGHTS appears deceptively simple, but its core mechanics demand careful planning, foresight, and problem-solving, making it a rewarding experience for puzzle enthusiasts of all skill levels.

The central gameplay mechanic revolves around the movement of a single chess piece: the knight. Players must navigate these knights across a grid to reach their designated colored spaces, but the L-shaped movement pattern of the knight introduces a layer of complexity that sets the game apart from typical grid-based puzzles. Success requires thinking several steps ahead, anticipating the consequences of each move, and finding elegant solutions that balance efficiency with strategy. As players progress through the game, puzzles grow more intricate, providing a steady and satisfying learning curve that keeps the challenges fresh and engaging.

Visually, KNIGHTS is defined by its minimalist and clean aesthetic. The grids, pieces, and targets are presented with simple, clear lines and a muted color palette, ensuring that the focus remains on strategic decision-making rather than extraneous visual elements. This simplicity enhances concentration and provides a calm, almost meditative atmosphere that complements the game’s methodical pacing. Additionally, a color-blind friendly palette ensures accessibility, allowing a wider audience to engage with the game without compromise.

A standout feature of KNIGHTS is its procedural generation system, which produces 75 new levels daily. This not only keeps the gameplay experience fresh but also offers virtually endless replayability, challenging players to continually refine their strategies and adapt to new configurations. With five progressively larger grid sizes, the game accommodates both casual players and those seeking more complex puzzles, offering a satisfying sense of progression as the challenges grow in difficulty and scale.

The auditory design of KNIGHTS further enhances its serene and focused environment. A soothing soundtrack, accompanied by subtle sound effects, reinforces the game’s calm ambiance and supports prolonged engagement with its puzzles. The audio cues are unobtrusive yet effective, creating a harmonious blend with the visual simplicity and strategic depth, making it easy for players to immerse themselves fully in the problem-solving experience.

Overall, KNIGHTS is a masterclass in minimalist game design, demonstrating how simplicity can coexist with intellectual depth. Its combination of thoughtful mechanics, clean visuals, and procedural content makes it a standout in the puzzle genre. The game rewards patience, strategic thinking, and careful planning, offering both short bursts of challenge and long-term engagement through daily generated puzzles. For players seeking a relaxing yet mentally stimulating experience, KNIGHTS provides a compelling and enduring journey that highlights the elegance of well-crafted puzzle design.

Super unique chess-themed puzzle game that has you moving knights to certain squares on boards of varying sizes.

There are both red and blue knights, that have allocated spots on the board they need to go, as well as yellow knights in later levels that serve no purpose but to get in your way. A level is completed when all blue knights are on blue squares, and red knights are on red squares.

There are 82 levels in total, divided into level packs named after the other chess pieces (Pawn, Rook, Bishop, Queen and King). Naturally, Pawn is the easiest pack whilst King is the most challenging. The boards also increase in size as the levels progress from a 3x3 all the way up to a 5x5.

Apart from the main levels, the game also offers daily levels, that can be unlocked after beating most main game levels. This offers another 75 puzzles that are randomly generated daily. This can sometimes lead to extremely easy puzzles whilst other times, it could be harder than any of the main game levels.

The music should also be mentioned. It's incredibly relaxing, a perfect fit for a game like this, and it makes the experience all the more enjoyable.

If you enjoy a unique puzzle experience, or you enjoy chess, then this is the game for you, it's very well worth its cheap price!

[h1]Les cavaliers vont devenir votre dada et votre cheval de bataille ![/h1]
[i]KNIGHTS[/i] est un jeu de réflexion captivant qui met à l'épreuve votre logique et votre patience. Le concept est simple : placer tous les cavaliers bleus et rouges sur les cases de leur couleur respective en les déplaçant selon les règles du jeu d'échecs. Cependant, ne vous y trompez pas, la simplicité apparente des règles cache une complexité croissante au fil des niveaux.
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
Le jeu introduit plusieurs éléments qui corsent la difficulté :
[list]
[*]Des cases inaccessibles
[*]Des cavaliers jaunes qui font obstacle
[*]Des grilles de plus en plus grandes
[/list]
Sur les grilles les plus imposantes, avec seulement quelques cases libres, attendez-vous à de véritables casse-têtes. L'intensité de la réflexion est telle qu'après 4 ou 5 grilles complexes consécutives, une pause s'impose à moi pour éviter la confusion mentale. Cette nécessité de fractionner les sessions de jeu n'est pas un défaut, mais plutôt une invitation à progresser par étapes.
[h3]Durée et contenu[/h3]
Pour obtenir les 20 succès du jeu, comptez environ 8-9 heures de jeu. Les collectionneurs apprécieront la possibilité de collecter des cartes Steam, une tâche qui peut être automatisée en environ 2-3 heures avec des outils comme [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/archiasf]ArchiSteamFarm[/url].
[h3]Recommandation[/h3]
[i]KNIGHTS[/i] est un incontournable pour les amateurs de puzzles et de casse-têtes. Son prix modique d'environ 1 euro en fait un excellent investissement pour enrichir votre ludothèque Steam. La progression bien dosée et le défi intellectuel qu'il propose en font une expérience satisfaisante et addictive.

Pour aller plus loin : Si ce jeu éveille votre curiosité pour les énigmes mathématiques liés aux déplacements du cavalier, vous pourriez vous intéresser au [url=https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Probl%C3%A8me_du_cavalier]problème du cavalier[/url], un défi classique de la théorie des graphes.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

There is a certain moment where it clicks. Until that moment it can seem confusing, easily getting into a mindless loop of moving pieces in circles without realizing it. 
Let me tell you two tips which will help you skip the frustration.

Tip 1:
I recommend starting each level by saying out loud and pointing at which colored (red or blue) squares are directly interchangeable in one move. Then which squares are interchangeable using one other square as a middleman in two moves. Then which squares are interchangeable when using two other squares as the middlemen in three moves.

Tip 2:
There are certain squares which are only accessible by one or two other spots, and are otherwise a "dead end". Locating these squares should be simple, and putting the yellow horses on them can simplify the board. It isn't necessary to put yellow horses on them, just be sure not to have any red or blue horses on them as they can get stuck there.

This should tell you enough information to solve every puzzle in the game and help you realize when the solution is right in front of you.
